input_release_geometry.source: frozen deterministic release-candidate binary mask on the event evaluation grid
input_release_geometry.boundary_conversion: union complete grid-cell polygons without smoothing or target-informed editing

release_state.thickness: event-specific validation-contract-v3 eligible evidence frozen without runout-target access
release_state.density: event-specific validation-contract-v3 eligible evidence frozen without runout-target access
release_state.sampling: one predeclared seeded joint draw per ensemble member; no runout-target conditioning
release_state.missing_thickness_or_density: hard failure; do not generate a runout

claim_boundary: This freezes conversion semantics only. It supplies no missing release observation, thickness, density, terrain, forcing, calibration, or validation evidence and authorizes no downstream run while the strict evidence gate fails.
prototype_disclaimer: Experimental research prototype only. It does not replace Avalanche Canada guidance or field assessment. Scores are relative indices, not probabilities.
